title: Calendar 1998 · Hemet copy
summary: Three-month screen calendar with printed emergency contacts for Hemet.
note: The printed contact list is historical. Printing requires a DOS printer. Set to 1998 in the emulator.

title: Calendar 1998 · Kern copy
summary: Same calendar logic, with a different printed contact list and first comment.
note: The printed contact list is historical. Printing requires a DOS printer. Set to 1998 in the emulator.

title: CALEND89
summary: An earlier three-month calendar and printout version.
note: Despite its name, the hard-coded weekday anchor matches January 1990. Set to 1990 in the emulator.

title: CALEND91
summary: Reworked calendar with a two-item menu.
note: Its print option jumps to the end. The weekday anchor matches 1990, despite the filename.

title: CALENDAR.111
summary: An intermediate tokenized calendar draft with a four-item menu.
note: Incomplete: it calls missing or wrong line targets and may stop with an error.

title: NEWCAL90
summary: A menu mockup for selecting a month, printing, choosing a printer, or quitting.

title: LOTTO
summary: Draws six numbers from 1 to 49 and explains how to handle repeats.
note: The code does not enforce unique numbers; rerun if duplicates appear.

title: MATHTEST
summary: Breaks an entered amount of cents into dollars and coins using integer division and MOD.
note: Enter a whole number of cents.

title: BILBOARD
summary: Animates family messages across an 80-column text screen.
note: Runs a long text animation; use Stop to leave it.

title: BASEBALL
summary: A baseball roster menu with placeholders for batting and alphabetical order.
note: The input branch goes straight to the retry message for valid choices.

title: TELEFONE
summary: A random-access address book using fixed 128-byte records.
note: The add form writes records, but search and exit control flow are unfinished. Changes live only in the browser session.

title: PRNTSTYL
summary: Prints a Citizen 180-D style chart using printer control codes.
note: It has no screen output; a printer is needed to see its result.

title: BAS_SEG
summary: Experiments with BASIC memory segments and variable pointers.
note: Output depends on GW-BASIC memory layout.

title: BSAVTEST
summary: Saves 16 bytes of segment E000 to a file named IRVING A. MEYERS.
note: Depends on DOS memory behavior; generated files live only in the browser session.

title: CLEAN
summary: Turns off function-key labels, sets colors, clears the screen, and issues NEW.
note: The screen becomes blank and GW-BASIC returns to its prompt.
